title: Compare procedures · variation 7
theme: Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater: a breakwater in a storm

points: An algorithm specifies precise steps; a program expresses a procedure in a programming language.
Identify inputs, processing and outputs. Trace intermediate state and check termination.
The register game is a small instruction language for algorithm practice, not C.
lesson.title: Algorithms

objective: Compare procedures: Compare doubling before addition with addition before doubling. double, then add 15. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 7, operand 15.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
